narrative:
## Handover Summary — Admin Expenses & Efficiency

Ten cost centres validated with headcount and non-headcount lines and driver-based items (market data terminals, card and ATM processing, third-party custody).

## Key Decisions
• Market-data renewal phased from January
• Card and ATM cost reduction as payments move to digital (−8%)
• Custody fees indexed to Tressis AUM

## Recommendation for CapEx
Prioritise the Spanish platform migration onto the group core banking instance — it removes duplicate licences and a reconciliation step in the group close.

signals.title: Efficiency ratio 60.1% vs EU average 55.0%
signals.excerpt: Staff costs +26% to €60.4M with 584 people, 30% more than three years ago.
